Hi Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. It needs a sign-off first.

A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure here. Those can only go to Anselm (CFO), June (deal desk) and the account owner. Hollis is Central team lead and isn't on that list, so June or Anselm has to approve before the rate goes in a mail to him, even as a draft. Your owning the account doesn't remove that step, because the rate would be going to someone else.

I've messaged June asking for approval and logged the request as pending. Once she or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox: to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", with the $2,356 per-seat figure. You can send it yourself from there.

If it's urgent, you could also ask June or Anselm directly.
